variants.title: Missing Tile by Cellwise XOR
skills: matrix reasoning, boolean composition, reduced output
variants.written_solution: Compute the missing tile by taking the cellwise XOR of the three visible tiles: a cell is present exactly when an odd number of the visible tiles occupy that position.
